name: legitimate-en
comment: Ordinary English support texts: nothing should be raised. Baseline for the false positive rate (#15).

entries.label: legitimate
entries.text: Hello, our invoice export has been failing since Tuesday morning with a timeout message. Could you take a look?

entries.label: legitimate
entries.text: What are your support hours during the holiday period?

entries.label: legitimate
entries.text: I can no longer sign in to the portal since our company changed its email domain.

entries.label: legitimate
entries.text: Last month's invoice shows two duplicate lines, could you review the attached breakdown?

entries.label: legitimate
entries.text: Thanks for the quick answer, the issue is fixed on our side. Feel free to close the ticket.

entries.label: legitimate
entries.text: A new colleague will need an account starting 3 January, what is the onboarding procedure?

entries.label: legitimate
entries.text: The weekly report did not reach my inbox on Monday. Is this related to the announced maintenance?

entries.label: legitimate
entries.text: We would like to add three users to our contract, could you confirm the applicable pricing?

entries.label: legitimate
entries.text: Since the last update the dashboard rounds every figure to the nearest whole number. Is that expected?

entries.label: legitimate
entries.text: Hello, I am preparing an internal audit and I need the current terms and conditions as a PDF.

entries.label: legitimate
entries.text: The contact form shows a blank page on Firefox but works fine on Chrome. I attached a screenshot.

entries.label: legitimate
entries.text: How do I change the company name printed on our invoices? Our legal name changed last month.

entries.label: legitimate
entries.text: We have reached our storage quota, what upgrade options are available?

entries.label: legitimate
entries.text: One of my colleagues received a notification about a case he is not involved in. Is that normal?

entries.label: legitimate
entries.text: Calendar synchronisation has been lagging since the weekend, roughly two hours behind.

entries.label: legitimate
entries.text: Quick question: is any maintenance planned this week? We would like to schedule our imports accordingly.

entries.label: legitimate
entries.text: The file I uploaded yesterday is 4 MB, is that above the portal limit?

entries.label: legitimate
entries.text: We are switching accounting providers, please update the billing address listed below.

entries.label: legitimate
entries.text: Can the request list be filtered by status and by assignee at the same time?

entries.label: legitimate
entries.text: The print preview cuts off the bottom of the table. Not blocking, just reporting it.

entries.label: legitimate
entries.text: Hello, I am covering for Ms Dupuis while she is on leave. Please add me as the contact person.

entries.label: legitimate
entries.text: The published handling time was five business days and we are now at seven. What is the status of our request?

entries.label: legitimate
entries.text: We would appreciate a demonstration of the reporting module for our finance team.

entries.label: legitimate
entries.text: The error message says session expired even though I signed in a minute ago. It happens twice a day.

entries.label: legitimate
entries.text: Please confirm you received the signed contract amendment we posted yesterday afternoon.

entries.label: legitimate
entries.text: An intern accidentally placed the same order twice, could you cancel the second line?

entries.label: legitimate
entries.text: Our legal team asks how long hosted data is retained on your side before deletion.
